_notes: Team identity: the English says 'Hangyul team' / 'Hangyul Univ team'; every '你的顾问' (your counselor) and the invented Chinese name '韩橘' were replaced with the official 'Hangyul 团队' / 'Hangyul Univ 团队' exactly as the English has it (V22 team display identity, glossary: never invent an institution name).
Official documents: 'standard admission letter' is always 标准入学许可书 (was 录取通知书 / 入学许可书 in two keys); apostille 海牙认证, consular legalization 领事认证, kept.

'managed applications' rendered as 代办申请 in all three places (was 与你共同管理的申请 / 代办申请学校 / 申请管理); 'personal statement and study plan editing' as 个人陈述与学习计划书修改 wherever the English spells it out, 文书修改 only where the English says 'essay editing'.
'program' is 专业 throughout; the eight keys that used 项目 were aligned.
'password (stored encrypted)' rendered literally as 密码（加密存储）; the old 密码哈希值 (password hash) is a technical claim the English does not make.

CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION summary: the old Chinese listed 传输的项目、时间、保存期限 (items, timing, retention) which the reviewed English does not; aligned to the English. Owner may want the Korean legal text checked if that list is required by PIPA notice rules.
mobile:login.networkError: the old Chinese carried Android-emulator developer instructions (10.0.2.2:8001) that are not in the English; replaced with the glossary 'can't be reached' wording.

mobile:plan.chooseLede: the old Chinese promised '覆盖整个申请流程' (covers the whole application process); replaced with the English meaning (one payment, no subscription, plan stays active while you prepare).

mobile:v3.discover.upTo 'Up to ₩{{amount}}M': rendered as 最高 {{amount}} 百万韩元 because the number cannot be rescaled; 500万 would need the amount in 万. Owner decision whether to format the amount for zh.

document = 文件 vs 材料: the Student web mixes both (upload sheet uses 文件, lists use 材料); only the one same-screen plural pair (v22.home.docsChecking_one/_other) was aligned. A single-term sweep is left to the owner; both are natural Chinese.
Analytical ratios in the University app ('{{n}} of {{d}}') rendered as {{n}}/{{d}} instead of '{{d}} 中的 {{n}}' which reverses the reading order.
'sees this exact text' rendered as 一字不差地看到这段文字; the old 原文 (original text) was ambiguous.
